Concern: A spec an agent can't misread. The study: Course: plan before you prompt; turn a vague idea into a spec with roles and constraints so the agent "doesn't have to guess". Same idea as lean's hypothesis-first build and eval-driven AI work. Test: every open work item names its done check and a prediction that can fail.

Mechanisms that should answer it: DECISIONS-1 (foundation/decisions.py); UNLEARN-DEV-1 (foundation/loopowner.py).

Metric: share of open work items (docs/issues) that carry both a done check and a checkable prediction, target >= 0.9. Improve the mechanism (or add one) until the probe passes; the white paper at /research updates itself from the same measurement.
